sentences.text: Hello, everyone. My name is Emili. Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. In this podcast,
we speak slow and easy English. Today, we talk about a beautiful island country. The country
is Curacao. Curacao is in the Caribbean Sea. It is a small island with beautiful beaches
and colorful buildings. Many people visit Curacao every year. Part two, Curacao is part of the
kingdom of the Netherlands. The island is located near the coast of South America.
It is close to Venezuela. The capital city of Curacao is Willemstad. Part three,
Willemstad is famous for its colorful houses. Many buildings are painted blue, yellow, pink,
and green. The city looks bright and cheerful. Visitors enjoy taking photos there.
Part four, the weather in Curacao is warm all year. The island has many sunny days.
People can enjoy outdoor activities in every season. The climate is perfect for beach holidays.
Part five, Curacao has many beautiful beaches. The water is clear and blue.
People enjoy swimming, snorkeling, and diving. The sea is one of the island's greatest treasures.
Part six, many colorful fish live in the waters around Curacao. Coral reefs can be found near the
coast. Divers from around the world visit the island. They come to explore the underwater world.
Part seven, people in Curacao speak several languages. One important language is Poppy
and Mentu. Many people also speak Dutch, English, and Spanish. This makes communication easy for
visitors. Part eight, music is an important part of life in Curacao. People enjoy dancing and
celebrating. Traditional music is played during festivals and special events. The island has a
part nine. Food in Curacao is delicious. People eat fish, seafood, rice, and vegetables. Many dishes
show influences from different cultures. Fresh tropical fruits are also very popular.
Part ten, the people of Curacao are friendly and welcoming. Tourism is important for the island.
Visitors often feel comfortable and relaxed. The atmosphere is peaceful and warm. Part 11,
nature in Curacao is also interesting. The island has beaches, caves, hills, and national parks.
People enjoy hiking and exploring nature. Many animals and birds live on the island.
